newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:
Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said Commissioner Monika Wulf-Mathies would hold a news conference on the integrated programme for Portugal's Alqueva region at 1500/1300 GMT.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/701: Proceedings against Belgium, Germany, Greece, France, Ireland, Italy, Portugal and Spain for non implementation of European directives on food.
- IP/97/702: Proceedings against Belgium, France, Germany, Ireland, Portugal and Austria for non implementation of directives on medical products.
- IP/97/703: Insurance: report on solvency margin.
- IP/97/704: Insurance: infringement proceedings against France and Spain.
- IP/97/705: Commission approves a joint venture between Thomson and Siemens in the air traffic management business.
- IP/97/706: Commission clears acquisition of Keiper Car Seating by Lear Corporation from the Keiper Recaro group.
- IP/97/708: Trade barriers: infringement proceedings against Belgium, Italy, the Netherlands, Spain and Greece.
- IP/97/709: Tha flower starts to bloom! 166 products receive EU Eco-label.
